name: Desh Rakshak Aushdhalaya Ltd.
summary: Desh Rakshak Aushdhalaya Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and supplying of pharmaceuticals, medicinal, chemical, and botanical products. It offers a portfolio of medicines under the ayurvedic and herbal solutions and is categorized into classical proprietary and patent medicines. The company was founded on September 14, 1981 and is headquartered in Haridwar, India.
